### Observed differences

- A01 is absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 traces) but appears in the later window in about 38 in 100 traces (77 of 200), exactly once per trace, around the middle of the case (median position about 0.45 of the trace length). In the later window its outgoing transitions go mainly to A09 (about 27%), A07 (about 23%) and A12 (about 19%), and it typically runs after A02, A03, A04, A07 or A11 and before A13. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL006, REL010, REL012]
- A17 shows the mirror image: it was executed in about 52 in 100 traces in the earlier window (105 of 200, about two occurrences per trace on average) and in 0 of 200 traces in the later window; earlier it led almost exclusively to A15 (about 53%) and A14 (about 46%). [OCC013, DIR017, POS017]
- A12's successors changed accordingly: earlier about 52% of its outgoing transitions went to A17 and about 47% to A16; later about 44% go to A16, about 29% to A15 and about 22% to A14, with none to A17. [DIR012]
- Late-process pairs moved about one step closer together: A14 preceded A13 at lag 5 in all earlier observations but at lag 4 in all later ones, A16→A13 likewise moved from lag 5 to lag 4, and A15→A14 and A15→A15 moved from mostly lag 4 to mostly lag 3. [LAG140, LAG157, LAG148, LAG149]
- A06 and A08 became less frequent: A06 ran in about 52 in 100 traces earlier versus about 31 in 100 later, A08 about 47 versus about 30; the two never share a trace in either window, and traces containing neither rose from about 2 in 100 to about 40 in 100. [OCC004, OCC005, REL068]
- Repetitions of A12 and A16 decreased modestly (mean occurrences per trace about 3.7 down to 3.2 for A12, and about 1.8 down to 1.4 for A16). [OCC008, OCC012]
- A13's successor mix changed (A02 fell from about 42% of its transitions to none, while A01, A06 and A10 appeared), but this rests on only about 19 outgoing transitions per window. [DIR013]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

One possibility strongly supported by the evidence is a structural change in which A01 was added to the process and A17 was removed from it. A01 moves from no observations to about 38 in 100 traces with a coherent mid-process placement, several predecessors (A02, A03, A04, A07, A11) and successors (A09, A07, A12); A17 moves from about 52 in 100 traces with about two occurrences each to no observations, its former predecessor A12 now routes to A15 and A14 instead, and late-block pairs (A14→A13, A16→A13, A15→A14) sit one step closer together, consistent with the tail of the trace becoming shorter. The key items exceed random re-split differences in about 995 of 1,000 reference comparisons, and the same picture recurs across occurrence, direction, position, relation and lag indicators, which a rare variant appearing in one window only would not produce at these participation levels. The evidence cannot show why the structure changed, and it cannot rule out that the two windows sample different case mixes rather than a modified process; the rerouting seen at A13 also rests on very few transitions. [OCC001, OCC013, DIR001, DIR012, DIR017, POS001, POS017, REL002, REL012, LAG140, LAG148, LAG157]

Other differences: A06 and A08 are executed in fewer traces and A12 and A16 repeat less often, which look like additional participation and repetition changes rather than part of the addition or removal above; A13's successor mix also changed, though with weak support. [OCC004, OCC005, OCC008, OCC012, DIR013, REL068]
